title: caralluma knobelii
intro: Caralluma knobelii, commonly known as Caralluma or "Famine Cactus", is a succulent plant species native to the Indian subcontinent. It has been traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine for its potential health benefits, which include weight loss, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Caralluma knobelii are attributed to its ability to suppress appetite and reduce food intake, as well as its potential to lower blood sugar levels and improve lipid profiles. The bioactive constituents of Caralluma knobelii include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
